notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may alter this loop to produce infinite creature tokens and sacrifice them for infinite colorless mana.
